brief.question: Build a native Mac app of Bogey Club that works fully without the Claude connection (local data storage, offline scorecard scan, saving files).
brief.purpose: The person wants to use their golf scorebook on the Mac independently of Claude.
constraints: Keep web/index.html, iOS app, Cloudflare hosting working unchanged
brief.done_when: A .app builds from the repo, opens the Bogey Club UI, stores players/courses/rounds/photos on the Mac, saves PDFs/backups, imports backups, and reads scorecard photos with Apple's on-device text recognition.

plan.title: Bogey-Club-Oberfläche für den Mac vorbereiten (ohne Claude, alles offline)
Speicher auf dem Mac für Spieler, Plätze, Runden und Bilder
Scorekarten-Foto offline mit der Mac-Texterkennung einlesen
Speichern von PDFs und Backups, Backup einspielen

handoff: Text recognition now: BogeyScan/ (shared Swift package, Apple Vision + ScorecardParser) used by mac/ (path dependency) and ios/ (XCLocalSwiftPackageReference ../../BogeyScan in pbxproj; ScorecardScanner.scan now returns Result{rows, info} built from ScanResult). Hosted web: server/ocr.js (JS port of ScorecardParser + Tesseract.js 5.1.1 from jsDelivr, PSM 6 full pass, ROI re-read), loaded lazily by server/runtime.js as claude.use("sample"); build.mjs copies it to public/. web/index.html: scan panel always shown, hint/busy text overridable via window.BOGEY_SCAN_HINT / BOGEY_SCAN_BUSY (set by mac/runtime.js and server/runtime.js). Verified: BogeyScan swift test 5/5, mac swift test 1/1, iOS simulator build succeeded (xcodebuild generic iOS Simulator, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO), JS parser matches Swift test cases in node, Tesseract read test card correctly in Node and WebKit except "11"→"1". Keep ocr.js and ScorecardParser.swift in sync. Open: real handwritten cards; save dialogs not click-tested; iOS app not run on device.
